comments.author: V_I
comments.body:
Well, to get the Aztec Calendar, you need:

E. Coast Latin America permit
Access to Tenochtitlan (via quest discovery, or by fleeting/pursuing someone who's discovered it)

But to get the Golden Clip, you need:

W. Coast Latin America permit
20-star relic discovery clue (one per clip)
Appropriate skills for relic discovery (you can fleet with somebody, but they'll need the 20-star clue themselves to access El Dorado, where actual relic discovery takes place)

And you can only get one GC per day, whereas there's no real limit on how many ACs you can obtain, (other than the cost of purchasing and storing, assuming you even bother to stash it in the bank to begin with. It's not too surprising that AC is more commonly sold than GC is.

Of course, a fellow company member recently found a Solomon's Key for sale in a London Comp Shop for 5mil... Go figure!
